name: Nulbin and Anoden
source:
Nulbin and Anoden (full names are Nulbin Amtingale and Anoden Amtingale) – are characters in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Nulbin and Anoden are nearly identical young twin brothers - except for eye color and scale tone, unsimilar to both their brother and father. Both are dark-blue, with light belly plates, light wing membranes and "elf" ear-like horns.
Both twin brothers love playing videogames and eating sweets, especially ice-cream, leading them to get sick time by time. Pretty impudent and jealous, leading to a brotherly rivalry.
